Dataset Forge Phase 6 synthetic software-testing reference.

Functional testing verifies that each user-facing workflow produces the expected result.

Negative testing checks invalid inputs, missing values, and rejected operations.

Boundary-value analysis exercises values at the lower and upper limits of an accepted range.

Accessibility testing verifies keyboard operation, visible focus, labels, and readable status feedback.

Regression testing reruns a stable scenario after a code change to detect unintended breakage.

Performance testing measures response time, throughput, and behavior under a defined workload.

API testing verifies request methods, status codes, response schemas, and authentication behavior.

Error handling checks that failures are safe, actionable, and do not expose internal details.

Data validation checks required fields, allowed values, and deterministic rejection messages.

Retry testing confirms transient failures do not create duplicate external jobs.

Cancellation testing confirms a user stop request prevents packaging and leaves inputs available.

Export testing verifies JSON and CSV contain the same final canonical records.
